subject.title: fix(tlon): stop monitor tracking state from growing forever

question: Should Tlon keep mention-free participation for only the 2,000 most recently accessed thread parents, accepting that an evicted thread requires a new bot mention?
rationale: The cap resolves process-lifetime growth but creates an intentional delivery window that source-level tests cannot decide for channel users.

options.title: Approve the LRU window
options.body: Accept bounded memory and require a fresh mention only after a thread falls out of the 2,000 most-recent participation window.

options.title: Choose another thread lifecycle
options.body: Keep the DM-invite snapshot cleanup but replace participated-thread eviction with an owner-defined retention policy that preserves the desired reply behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve the LRU window
recommendation.body: Accept bounded memory and require a fresh mention only after a thread falls out of the 2,000 most-recent participation window.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned reviewer authored the final policy-shaping commits and is the strongest available routing candidate for this Tlon behavior decision.
